_about: Why a string changed in the 29 Oct language round and which facts it depends on. Read by tools/language/ledger.mjs. Keys: copy keys without the 'copy.' prefix, or full ledger keys (page.*, product.*, category.*). '*' applies to every country.

add.reason: Functional layer: verbal noun, the wording local stores use; no feminine/masculine object pronoun forced onto every product.

reco_add.reason: Same wording as the main add-to-cart button.

place.reason: The order is confirmed later by a call; a button saying 'confirm' next to 'not confirmed yet' contradicted itself. 'Send the order' says what happens.

nav_faq.reason: Navigation in the standard label local stores use.

nav_contact.reason: Navigation label in plain Arabic (feminine imperative kept as brand voice).

breadcrumb.reason: Accessibility label read by screen readers: neutral and descriptive, not a conversational question.

unverified.reason: Placeholder for an unknown spec (local and staging only): neutral wording.

fit_q.reason: Technical fit section: a clear neutral question; the previous line was vague and forced a feminine agreement.
fit_q.facts: Only shown with real dimensions; mats sizes and rack width still unknown (O6), catalog gate blocks both.

why.reason: Products differ in gender and number; speak of 'the product', not 'her' (ـها).

max_qty.reason: '%d قطع' is only correct for 3-10; the new form avoids Arabic plural agreement with the number.

results.reason: '%d منتج' is wrong for 3-10; label form avoids plural agreement.

confirm_call.reason: Removed the 24-hour and same-day promises: they come from the supplier's publication, not from orders we observed.
confirm_call.facts: Who calls and when: verification task P0-8 (caller identity, timing). Reinstate timing only after test orders.

privacy_note.reason: 'only to deliver your order' was too absolute: we also confirm, support, and prevent fake orders (YM_Risk), and marketing is separate and optional.
privacy_note.facts: Matches the privacy page and YM_Risk / YM_Mail behaviour.

home_steps.reason: Removed the unproven 'in a minute'; the first step now says she sends the order from the site (matches the button).

thanks_steps.reason: 'طلبك لسه مش متأكد' sounded unsure; now: we received it, a call confirms it, nothing ships before the call. Agentless ('a call will reach you'): who calls is not verified yet.
thanks_steps.facts: Confirmation call before shipping: supplier process, verification P0-8.

mail_received_body.reason: Same correction as thanks_steps, in the receipt email.

mail_delivered_subject.reason: The subject promised usage tips that the email did not contain.

thanks.reason: 'وصلنا طلبك' can be read as 'we delivered your order' without the shadda; 'استلمنا' is unambiguous.

subtotal_label.reason: New (review §4): label of the total row before a governorate is chosen, so no amount is shown as payable on delivery while the fee is unknown.

delivery_after_gov.reason: New (review §4): shown next to the products subtotal until a governorate is chosen.

news_confirm_q.reason: New: the confirmation link now opens a page with one button (mail scanners can no longer confirm).

news_unsub_q.reason: New: the unsubscribe link opens a page with one button; mail clients still use one-click POST.

cart_totals.reason: New: overrides WooCommerce's 'إجمالي سلة المشتريات' found by the rendered-page inventory.

fix_these.reason: New: overrides WooCommerce's 'تم العثور على المشكلات الآتية:' with a softer, actionable line.

skip_link.reason: New: overrides WordPress's masculine 'تخطى إلى المحتوى' with a neutral noun.

news_body.facts: The one-a-week promise is now enforced across stores and flows (YM_Mail::CAP_WEEK = 1, row-locked).

payment.facts: Opening the parcel after paying: supplier policy as published, not observed (P0-8).

returns.facts: Egypt: 14 days for a defect, as published by the supplier. Iraq: unknown (3 or 14 days), so empty.

home_trust.facts: 'Delivery to every governorate' rests on the supplier's fee table, not delivered orders (checklist #14).

one_fee.facts: One delivery fee per order: supplier's published rule (DECISIONS 28 Oct).

category.laundry.reason: Navigation: the same standard word in every country (was Egyptian 'الهدوم').

product.EG030106MKKT99.name.reason: 'فائق الامتصاص' is a supplier-title claim without product evidence; the name now says what it is.

product.EG030106MKKT99.benefit.reason: Removed the performance claim; says where the pieces go.

product.EG030106MKKT99.fit.reason: Points to the sizes in the specs instead of comparing with sizes the store does not have.

product.EG030106MKKT99.benefit1.text.reason: 'سطح فائق الامتصاص حسب مواصفات المورد' repeated an unverified supplier claim.

product.EG030108BUND99.saving.facts: 49 = 2 x 399 - 749; checked by an in-store test (saving_parts).

product.IQ030403SENK99.note.reason: Removed: it stated a price with delivery in text, which goes stale when a price or fee changes; the page computes totals.

product.IQ030403SENK99.diary.reason: The diary note repeated the fit instruction; now one practical habit.

product.IQ030501SDMN99.name.reason: 'موكيت' (carpet) replaced by 'دواسات' (mats) for the mats in this bundle.

product.IQ030501SDMN99.note.reason: No price in text; states the one-delivery-fee fact instead.
product.IQ030501SDMN99.note.facts: One delivery fee per order (supplier rule).

mail_delivered_body.reason: 'زين لو مو زين' reads Gulf-adjacent (voice guide); plain Iraqi instead.

home_cta.reason: Spelling policy: standard ق in تسوّقي (was تسوكي).
